note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the event and the obligations are generic placeholders, never real contract text. The two rooms are identical except the supplied state of the event — produced or pending, supplied states of equal weight (● and ◆ of the same area, colour and stroke). The bracket only MARKS the supplied tranche, as the supplied configuration of each room; no winner, score or outcome. No rule on conditions is stated: no condition precedent or subsequent, no fulfilment, no automatic effect, no obligation that becomes due, binding or enforceable, and no jurisdiction. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the event card and the obligation cards stand for the clauses), schedules, definitions and priorities (no priority or order between obligations is drawn). No stress field is capped.
